articles.title: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda abroad
articles.description:
Support such as for white Afrikaners and anti-communism reveals how US is redefining what qualifies as human rights
With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”.
On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests not to do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The state department declined to comment on questions from the Guardian specifically on whether it had obligated the funds and had “blown” holds from Congress due to concerns about the money’s use.

articles.description:
President announces measures amid anger at authorities over recent murders of women
South Africa’s president has called on men to take more responsibility for violence against women as he announced measures to tackle the problem, amid anger at authorities over a recent wave of murders.
Cyril Ramaphosa acknowledged that not enough had been done to protect women. He said police would be reviewing unsolved murders, attempted murders and serious sexual offences against women and children, as well as producing a funded plan to reduce the forensic backlog for such cases, both within 60 days.

Burundi joins several other African nations in accepting people deported under Trump’s hardline policy
Burundi has agreed to join a clutch of ⁠other African nations in receiving migrants from other countries deported from the US under ⁠Donald Trump’s hardline ⁠immigration ​policy.
However, Burundi will only accept those not accused of crime or terrorism links, said ⁠Nancy Ninette Mutoni, a spokesperson for the country’s president, Évariste Ndayishimiye. Tuesday’s announcement gave no details of numbers, timing or financial ⁠details.

articles.title: DRC politician beaten to death after radio appearance about Ebola outbreak
articles.description:
Marie-Celestin Karondwa was attacked on Sunday after promoting measures to prevent spread of disease, his party says

A senior member of the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s ruling party was beaten to death on Sunday after appearing on a radio programme to raise awareness about the Ebola outbreak, a party representative has said.
Marie-Celestin Karondwa, the acting president of the Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS) party’s federal executive committee in Butembo, a new hotspot for the outbreak, was attacked after taking part in a ​radio show during which he ‌promoted prevention measures for the disease, ‌the UDPS federation in the city said in a statement, Reuters reported.

articles.description:
Seventeen people killed near Johannesburg in suspected ‘illegal goldmining turf war’, as 10 killed in separate incident at barbecue venue near Cape Town
Two separate mass shootings near South Africa’s two biggest cities killed at least 27 people, as the country grapples with one of the world’s highest murder rates amid investigations into corruption and criminality within the police.
The South African police service said on Sunday that 17 people were killed on Saturday night when eight suspects armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols opened fire at a bar in Wedela township, about 50 miles south-west of central Johannesburg. At least 15 other people sustained gunshot injuries in that attack, police said.

articles.description:
Hurricane Nolo is moving away from Hawaiian islands but threat of heavy rain, flash floods and strong winds persists
Hurricane Nolo was moving away from the Hawaiian islands on Sunday, but the threat of heavy rain, flash flooding and strong winds persisted in areas of the island chain still recovering from previous storms.
Nolo was about 365 miles (585km) south-south-west of Honolulu and moving away from the Big Island at about 12mph (19km/h). But the Hawaii county civil defense agency said a high wind warning, wind advisory and high surf advisory remained in effect for parts of the island through Sunday evening as Nolo’s maximum sustained winds rose to 115mph.

articles.summary: 2021年11月に移民ボートが沈没し31人が死亡した英仏海峡遭難事件で、2つの密航組織に属する男6人が過失致死罪で投獄された。

articles.title: Dozens hurt and hundreds arrested in wave of French school protests
articles.description: Students have been protesting against conditions and resources in secondary schools since last week.
articles.titleJa: フランスの学校抗議デモの波で数十人が負傷、数百人が逮捕
articles.summary: 先週からフランスの学生たちが、中学校の状況と資源不足に抗議。数十人が負傷し、数百人が逮捕された。

articles.title: Ukraine's prized steel industry left in ruins by Russian missile campaign
articles.description: Ukraine's remaining steelworks, a vital part of its economy, have all but ground to a halt because of relentless attacks.

articles.title: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
articles.description: The ban is part of a number of proposals that must be approved in parliament within 30 days.
articles.titleJa: 87歳女性の立ち退き抗議を受け、スペインが立ち退き禁止を発表
articles.summary: 87歳の女性の立ち退きを巡る抗議を受け、スペイン政府は立ち退き禁止を発表。この提案は30日以内に議会で承認される必要がある。

articles.title: French hard-right leader accuses opponents of 'total war' after claims of antisemitism
articles.description: National Rally President Jordan Bardella says he will sue for libel over comments he is accused of making as a young activist.
articles.titleJa: フランスの極右指導者、反ユダヤ主義の主張を受け「全面戦争」を宣言
articles.summary: 国民連合のジョルダン・バルデラ党首は、若き活動家時代の発言が反ユダヤ主義と非難されたことを受け、名誉毀損で訴訟を起こすと表明した。

articles.title: Dutch police arrest suspected member of group that claimed FBI hack
articles.description: The suspect, 24, was arrested before the alleged cyber attack took place.
articles.titleJa: オランダ警察、FBIハッキングを主張したグループの容疑者を逮捕
articles.summary: オランダ警察が、FBIへのサイバー攻撃を主張したグループのメンバーとされる24歳の容疑者を逮捕。逮捕はサイバー攻撃が起こる前に行われた。

articles.title: Brexit referendum 'possible' in Labour election manifesto, says Burnham
articles.description: The PM says a referendum wouldn't be the right thing now but the UK needs to consider its options for the future.
articles.titleJa: 労働党の選挙公約にブレグジット国民投票が「可能性あり」とバーナム氏
articles.summary: バーナム氏は、労働党の選挙公約にブレグジット国民投票の可能性を示唆。首相は現時点では適切でないとしつつ、英国は将来の選択肢を検討する必要があると述べた。

articles.title: Estonia blames Russia for arson at defence company supplying Ukraine
articles.description: Russia has been accused of launching sabotage attacks across a number of European Nato countries which have been helping Ukraine.
articles.titleJa: エストニア、ウクライナ供給の防衛企業への放火でロシアを非難
articles.summary: エストニアは、ウクライナに兵器を供給する防衛企業への放火についてロシアを非難。ロシアは複数のNATO加盟国で妨害工作を行っているとされる。

articles.title: 'I was lured into a trap': Evan Gershkovich on moment that led to 16 months in Russian jail
articles.description: The US journalist says he realised he was a "a pawn in a greater game" when he was not interrogated or tortured by FSB agents.
articles.titleJa: 「罠に誘い込まれた」：エヴァン・ゲルシュコビッチ氏が語る、ロシアでの16ヶ月拘留に至った瞬間
articles.summary: 米国人ジャーナリストのエヴァン・ゲルシュコビッチ氏は、FSB捜査官から尋問や拷問を受けず、自分が「より大きなゲームの駒」だと悟った瞬間を語った。

articles.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
articles.description: The storm moved ashore on the Baja California peninsula, which is a popular tourist destination.
articles.titleJa: ハリケーン・ポロ、メキシコ太平洋岸に上陸
articles.summary: ハリケーン「ポロ」がメキシコのバハ・カリフォルニア半島に上陸。人気観光地が暴風雨に見舞われた。

articles.title: Venezuelan man shot by ICE in Texas is charged with assault
articles.description: Wilber Rafael Garces-Perez is accused of striking an agent with his car's side-view mirror while driving away.
articles.titleJa: テキサス州でICEに銃撃されたベネズエラ人男性が暴行罪で起訴
articles.summary: テキサス州でICEに撃たれたベネズエラ人男性が、逃走中に捜査官を車のサイドミラーで叩いたとして暴行罪で起訴された。

articles.title: Mexico's National Guard debuts chihuahua dog recruit named 'Comando'
articles.description: The 13-month-old small canine is equipped with protective gear and a camera, and is being trained for search-and-rescue missions.
articles.titleJa: メキシコ国家警備隊、チワワ犬の新兵「コマンド」を初公開
articles.summary: メキシコ国家警備隊が、保護具とカメラを装備した13ヶ月のチワワ犬「コマンド」を公開。捜索救助任務の訓練を受けている。

articles.title: Argentina threatens legal action against UK over Falkland Islands oil exploration
articles.description: President Javier Milei set a two-week deadline for the Sea Lion oilfield project to be scrapped.
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチン、フォークランド諸島沖での石油探査を巡り英国を提訴すると警告
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領は、フォークランド諸島沖の「シーライオン油田プロジェクト」中止を英国に要求し、2週間の期限を設定。法的措置を警告した。

articles.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
articles.description: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ、選挙要求の高まりを受け数十人の政治犯を釈放
articles.summary: ベネズエラで数十人の政治犯が釈放された。これは暫定指導者が米国大統領と会談した数日後のことで、選挙を求める声が高まっている。

articles.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election
articles.description: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".
articles.titleJa: ブラジルのルーラ大統領、大統領選を前にオンラインギャンブルを禁止
articles.summary: ブラジルのルーラ大統領が、大統領選挙を前にオンラインギャンブルを禁止。彼はこの業界を「癌」と表現し、排除すると述べた。

articles.title: Venezuela's interim president promises election after Maduro ousted
articles.description: The opposition in Venezuela has slammed her for not setting even a tentative date for elections.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの暫定大統領、マドゥロ追放後の選挙を約束
articles.summary: ベネズエラの暫定大統領が、マドゥロ追放後の選挙を約束した。しかし、野党は選挙の暫定日程すら示さないことに強く反発している。

articles.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
articles.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
articles.titleJa: 新種の野生ネコ科動物を発見 - 唯一の生存個体しか知られていない
articles.summary: ボリビアで、これまで近縁種と誤認されていたまだら模様の野生ネコ科動物が新種として特定された。現存する個体は1頭のみ。

articles.title: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US
articles.description: Haitian immigrants make up a large portion of the already overburdened home-care workforce.
articles.titleJa: 「彼は命綱だった」－米国でハイチ人介護者が解雇され、家族が途方に暮れる
articles.summary: 米国で働くハイチ人介護者が職を失い、介護を必要とする家族が困窮。ハイチ人移民は過重労働の在宅介護労働力の多くを占めている。

articles.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
articles.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の反応が鍵に
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島を巡る「変化の風」を約束する中、ドナルド・トランプ氏が英国の統治に対する姿勢を変えるかどうかが注目される。

articles.title: In Brazil’s capital, residents grow their own heat-fighting solutions
articles.description: Life in the favelas surrounding Brazil’s capital brings the health risks of extreme heat — a symptom of the global inequities of green space access
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの首都で、住民たちが独自の暑さ対策を育む
articles.summary: ブラジルの首都周辺のファベーラでは、住民が猛暑による健康リスクに直面。緑地へのアクセスにおける世界的な不平等を背景に、独自の暑さ対策に取り組んでいる。

articles.title: Equating protest with terrorism: A narrative against dissent
articles.description: In this month's edition, we dive deep into a narrative used by leaders in the United States and other countries to delegitimize protests.
articles.titleJa: 抗議活動をテロと同一視する：異議申し立てに反対する言説
articles.summary: 米国をはじめとする各国の指導者が、抗議活動をテロと同一視することで、異議申し立てを不当なものとする言説について深く掘り下げて分析する。

articles.title: The commodification of Indigenous cultures and traditions
articles.description: Too often, resources and meaning flow outward from the community that created them and enrich outsiders — often the same groups that have been oppressing them for centuries.
articles.titleJa: 先住民族の文化と伝統の商業化
articles.summary: 先住民族が生み出した資源や意味が、しばしば外部に流出し、数世紀にわたり彼らを抑圧してきた人々を潤すという問題について論じている。

articles.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
articles.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
articles.titleJa: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルのホセ・セラーノ元大臣が逮捕される
articles.summary: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルの元「スーパー大臣」が、適正手続きに疑問符が付く司法制度のもと、重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面している。

articles.title: The A’uwẽ-Xavante people's denunciation of megaprojects in Brazil
articles.description: An Indigenous-led campaign denounces the impacts of a mega railway project and demands respect for territory, self-determination, and the right to live and dream.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルにおけるアウウェ・シャバンテ族による巨大プロジェクトの非難
articles.summary: 先住民族主導のキャンペーンが、巨大鉄道プロジェクトの影響を非難し、領土、自己決定、そして生きる権利の尊重を求めている。

articles.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
articles.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
articles.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
articles.summary: コロンビアのペレイラで、地震の生存者たちが日払い部屋での生活を余儀なくされ、ホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして公式に数えられない苦境に直面。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震により子どもたちがトラウマ、避難、食料不安に直面
articles.summary: ベネズエラでの地震後、家族が避難する中で、幼い子どもたちが恐怖、日常の乱れ、基本的な栄養確保の喪失といったトラウマに苦しんでいる。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民族殺害が増加
articles.summary: 政治的・経済的圧力の増大により、ブラジルで先住民族に対する暴力が増加。これは権利の枠組みの行き詰まりと土地境界線策定への圧力に関連している。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「大地の溜め息」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ドキュメンタリー写真、個人の証言、デジタル介入を組み合わせたプロジェクトが、ベネズエラ地震後に十分報道されていないコミュニティの被災状況を記録する。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震から1ヶ月以上が経過し、数千人の親族が、厳しい状況と不十分な支援にもかかわらず、倒壊した建物のそばで肉親の捜索を続けている。

articles.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes on Afghanistan
articles.description: The Afghan Taliban says nine civilians have died while Pakistan says the strikes killed 22 militants.
articles.titleJa: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに致命的な空爆を実施
articles.summary: パキスタンがアフガニスタンに空爆を実施し、タリバンは民間人9人の死亡を報告、パキスタンは武装勢力22人を殺害したと主張。

articles.title: Inside India's forest villages, where a dangerous mix of crises led to 32 child deaths
articles.description: At least 32 children have died in India's Balaghat district since May amid outbreaks of measles and malaria.
articles.titleJa: インドの森林村で危機が重なり子ども32人が死亡
articles.summary: インドのバラガート地区で5月以降、はしかとマラリアの発生により、少なくとも32人の子どもが死亡。

articles.title: China has cracked down on AI relationships. Is it ahead of the game?
articles.description: Beijing has cracked down on AI chatbots that can replicate human relationships. Experts are asking if this is the right thing to do.
articles.titleJa: 中国がAIとの関係を厳しく取り締まり。時代を先取りしているのか？
articles.summary: 北京が人間関係を模倣するAIチャットボットを取り締まり。専門家は、この措置が適切か議論している。

articles.title: Trekkers helicoptered off mountains as more deadly landslides hit Nepal
articles.description: A month after mass catastrophic flooding, around 30 people have died in landslides and heavy rain.
articles.titleJa: ネパールでさらなる致命的な地滑りが発生、登山者がヘリコプターで救出される
articles.summary: ネパールで壊滅的な洪水から1か月後、地滑りと豪雨により約30人が死亡。登山者がヘリコプターで救助された。

articles.title: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
articles.description: British universities are being urged to sever ties with China General Technology Research Institute which is linked to the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS).
articles.titleJa: 中国が英国の研究に資金提供し、北京のスパイに送っているとMI5が警告
articles.summary: MI5は、中国が英国の研究に資金提供し、中国の国家安全省に情報を送っていると警告。英国の大学は中国企業との関係断絶を求められている。

articles.title: 'He will never walk free': Indian judge's letter promises child sex abuse survivor
articles.description: In the emotional letter, the judge describes the survivor as "the bravest little girl this court has ever seen".
articles.titleJa: 「彼は決して自由にはならない」：インド人判事が児童性的虐待の生存者に約束の手紙
articles.summary: インド人判事が児童性的虐待の生存者へ感情的な手紙を送り、加害者が決して釈放されないことを約束し、生存者を「最も勇敢な少女」と称賛した。

articles.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
articles.description: The launch of FirstDate comes as the ageing nation wrestles with a record-low fertility rate.
articles.titleJa: シンガポールが公務員向けお見合いサービスを開始
articles.summary: シンガポールが公務員向けにお見合いサービス「ファーストデート」を開始。高齢化と過去最低の出生率に悩む国の課題解決を目指す。

articles.title: Watch: Couple describe relief at rescue after whale destroys their yacht
articles.description: Jeremy and Jemma Cooper were 500 miles off the coast of New Zealand when their yacht, the Tai Tam, collided with a sperm whale.
articles.titleJa: クジラがヨットを破壊後、救助され安堵する夫婦の様子
articles.summary: ニュージーランド沖500マイルで、夫妻のヨットがマッコウクジラと衝突し破壊された。無事救助され、その安堵の様子を語る。

articles.title: Restaurant named after Xi Jinping attacked by Chinese nationals in South Korea
articles.description: The owner said he chose the name because he wanted to run the "best Chinese restaurant" in South Korea.
articles.titleJa: 習近平にちなんで名付けられたレストランが韓国で中国人によって襲撃される
articles.summary: 韓国で習近平国家主席にちなんで名付けられた中国料理店が、中国人によって襲撃された。店主は「最高の中国料理店」にしたかったと語る。

articles.title: 'He's taught us courage': Friend on Indian pilot hailed as a hero
articles.description: Capt Smit Machchhar was attacked by another pilot onboard the Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv.
articles.titleJa: 「彼は私たちに勇気を教えてくれた」：インド人パイロットを英雄と称える友人
articles.summary: テルアビブ行きのフライドバイ便で、インド人パイロットが別のパイロットに襲撃された。友人は彼を英雄と称え、勇気を教えてくれたと語る。

articles.title: Director-General cites concerns with pace of negotiations as chairs report on state of play
articles.description: A meeting of the Trade Negotiations Committee (TNC) on 1 October provided WTO members with an opportunity to take stock of the WTO's negotiating agenda six months after the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in Yaoundé and voice their views on how to advance their work. Members heard readouts from the chairs of the negotiating bodies about the state of play in their respective talks.
articles.titleJa: 事務局長、交渉の進捗に懸念を表明、議長らが現状を報告
articles.summary: WTO貿易交渉委員会会合で、事務局長が交渉の遅れに懸念を示し、今後の作業進捗について議長らが報告した。

articles.title: John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition kicks off with webinar support on offer
articles.description: Prospective participants in the 25th edition of the John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition on WTO Law, launched on 16 September 2026, are invited to attend webinars aimed at helping them to effectively participate in the competition.
articles.titleJa: ジョン・H・ジャクソン・模擬裁判大会、ウェビナーサポート付きで開幕
articles.summary: 第25回ジョン・H・ジャクソンWTO法模擬裁判大会が開始され、参加者向けに効果的な参加を支援するウェビナーが提供される。

articles.title: WTO members deepen discussions on trade and climate measures, share updates
articles.description: The Committee on Trade and Environment (CTE) met on 28-29 September to advance its discussions on the trade and environment nexus, focusing on interoperability and development aspects of trade-related climate measures. Members also built on the voluntary information sharing exercise launched earlier this year with a view to enhancing transparency of trade and climate measures in the Committee. In addition, they were briefed on work undertaken in other international fora and on developments in several member-led environmental initiatives at the WTO.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、貿易と気候変動対策に関する議論を深化させ、最新情報を共有
articles.summary: WTO貿易環境委員会が開催され、貿易と気候変動対策の関連性について議論を深め、透明性向上のための情報共有が進められた。

articles.title: New Zealand advances safe and inclusive trade with new contribution to STDF
articles.description: New Zealand has contributed NZ$ 300,000 (approximately CHF 140,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) to help developing and least-developed countries, including in the Pacific, strengthen food safety and animal and plant health systems.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド、STDFに新たな貢献を行い、安全で包摂的な貿易を推進
articles.summary: ニュージーランドがSTDFに30万NZドルを拠出し、途上国の食品安全、動植物衛生システムの強化を支援し、貿易を促進する。

articles.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
articles.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.
articles.titleJa: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行が「開発のためのサービス貿易」構想をアジア太平洋にもたらす
articles.summary: WTO、アジア開発銀行、世界銀行がマニラで会議を共催し、「開発のためのサービス貿易」構想をアジア太平洋に導入、地域貿易関係者が議論した。

articles.title: Panel to review EU carbon border adjustment mechanism and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: The Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) agreed at its meeting on 25 September to a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances.
articles.titleJa: EU炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度の審査パネルが設置へ
articles.summary: WTO紛争解決機関がロシアの要請を受け、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度の輸出補助金疑惑を審査するパネル設置に合意した。

articles.title: Members review farm policies in first meeting under new Chair
articles.description: At a meeting of the WTO Committee on Agriculture on 24-25 September, WTO members addressed matters raised regarding implementation of their commitments and members' specific notifications. They also discussed a counter-notification submitted by Australia on India's support policies for sugar and heard a briefing on the global state of farming from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). This was the first meeting under the new Chair, Mr William Horgan of Ireland.
articles.titleJa: 新議長の下で初の会合、加盟国が農業政策を再検討
articles.summary: WTO農業委員会で新議長の下、初の会合が開催。加盟国は農業政策の実施状況や、オーストラリアによるインドの砂糖政策への異議を議論した。

articles.title: WTO members review agriculture negotiation history, discuss ways forward
articles.description: WTO members expressed their views on 23 September regarding the current state of the agriculture negotiations and how best to move them forward following the inconclusive outcome of talks in this area at the WTO’s 14th Ministerial Conference in Yaoundé earlier this year.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、農業交渉の歴史を振り返り、今後の進め方を議論
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は、前回の閣僚会議で結論が出なかった農業交渉の現状を振り返り、今後の進め方について意見を表明した。

articles.title: A critical juncture for the world trading system: what the evidence tells us
articles.description: The multilateral trading system has underpinned a nearly 50-fold expansion of world merchandise trade volume and one of the most remarkable periods of economic growth and development in modern history, yet global trade policy and the WTO are experiencing the most serious and sustained disruptions since the system was created 80 years ago.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易システムにとっての岐路：証拠が示すもの
articles.summary: 世界貿易システムは過去80年で最も深刻な混乱に直面しており、多角的貿易システムが経済成長を支えてきたが、今は重要な転換点にある。

articles.title: Tariffs applied by WTO members have decreased by a third since 1996
articles.description: Update of data blog first published on 13 April 2023.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国による関税、1996年以降3分の1減少
articles.summary: WTO加盟国が適用する関税が1996年以降3分の1減少したというデータが更新された。
